svg.title: Gargoyle: section · close-up in context
svg.desc: Section through a parapet gutter and gargoyle: rain runs off the lead roof into the gutter, through a channel inside a stone beast that projects far enough to throw the water clear of the wall, with a shaded round close-up of the carved head: mane, brow, eye, snarling mouth with fangs, and ear. Source: Original drawing by Project Exodus from the standard geometric construction of this form; no external drawing reproduced.

g.text: CLOSE-UP · ×5 · HEAD PROJECTS 1300 mm · LIGHT FROM THE UPPER LEFT
CARVED WATER SPOUT PROJECTING FROM A ROOF
SOURCE: Original drawing by Project Exodus from the standard geometric
construction of this form; no external drawing reproduced.
